name: Bran Bhata
residence: Kiln District (near the firewood supply paths)
personality: suspicious of outsiders and soft thinking
highly attentive to how fast the woodland is thinning
loyal to trusted people and cold to others
daily_routine: coordinating timber routes for the brick kilns
checking which groves are safe to cut without stripping them bare
escorting woodcutters into farther stands of scrub and tamarisk
monitoring the kiln fires so bricks fire evenly
reporting when a grove yields less wood than the year before
trading surplus baked brick in the Lower Town

goals.public_goal: Keep the kilns fed with fuel so building brick never runs short, and keep woodcutters safe
goals.hidden_goal: Track how far the cutting boundary has crept outward year over year
goals.deep_goal: Understand whether the kilns themselves are quietly starving the land that feeds them

beliefs: A kiln that outlives its woodland was never sustainable to begin with
The elders undercount how much timber a season of brick-firing truly costs
Old cutting-lines don't lie, even when people prefer not to read them
Ancestors' warnings about the far groves usually trace back to a real, specific loss
The Assembly assumes the woodland will always regrow in time
